open_obligations.what_is_open: Find and exactly certify a minimum-degree-two repeated motif on which the optimized feasible quadratic weight has strictly smaller worst bounded-schedule conditional variance than the GaoHarshawSavjeWang2026 weight.
open_obligations.obstruction: Complement symmetry and convexity rule out every motif of maximum degree at most three, including the complete four-vertex graph and the diamond. The exact complete-five-vertex calculation also makes the Gao weight the unique minimizer. A remaining witness must therefore use some other motif having a vertex of degree at least four, and no exact robust-program certificate for such a motif is present in the frozen core.
open_obligations.attempted: The degree-three moment family was parameterized exactly and killed by the complement-symmetry convexity argument. The next complete motif was then enumerated exactly; its pointwise bounded-outcome envelope gives the upper value 2560, while a constant legal schedule gives a positive-definite lower certificate with equality only at the Gao weight.

prose_updates.tldr: Using the Bernoulli-half moment-reproduction identities and quadratic weight imported from GaoHarshawSavjeWang2026 Section 4 and Appendix B, this project studies a fixed network motif repeated under Bernoulli assignment. A \(2^h\)-row assignment table yields an exact robust semialgebraic program for the attained worst-schedule assignment-conditional variance and its least-favourable-prior dual. For a LinkedIn-style Bernoulli network experiment with a known repeated local motif, the contact-set certificate selects among feasible exposure-quadratic weights by the smallest worst bounded-schedule conditional-variance constant. The same table gives the explicit affinity factor \(L_H\), with exact constants for \(K_3\) and \(C_4\). The optimal quadratic statistic is calibrated at finite-sample level over every bounded no-spillover schedule, and its fourth-root RMS signal scale is unavoidable for every measurable test. A maximality audit proves that Gao's weight is minimax for every minimum-degree-two motif of maximum degree at most three and is the unique minimizer on the complete five-vertex motif, so no strict weight improvement is claimed from these smallest non-degree-two cases. Whether another motif with maximum degree at least four yields a strict weight gain, and whether the quadratic test attains the exact local power constant, remain open.

project_justification.fill: The project computes the attained variance saddle from a \(2^h\)-row robust semialgebraic program, derives exact worst-null calibration by finite assignment and sign-pattern enumeration, and proves a matching all-test fourth-root lower bound with an explicit motif-computable Hellinger constant and exact \(K_3\) and \(C_4\) values. The maximality audit additionally proves that the published Gao weight cannot be strictly improved within the quadratic class on any minimum-degree-two motif of maximum degree at most three and is uniquely minimax on the complete five-vertex motif; a strict witness on another motif of maximum degree at least four is not claimed.

prose_updates.related_work: The Bernoulli-half moment-reproduction identities and quadratic weight are imported as background from GaoHarshawSavjeWang2026 arXiv version 2 Section 4 and Appendix B. Its Proposition 4.1 gives a \(d_{\max}^5/n\) MSE envelope using the variance ingredients in Lemmas S3--S4. This paper is an informed-by comparator: the new repeated-motif results identify attained worst-schedule conditional-variance constants for \(K_3\) and \(C_4\), provide exact composite-null calibration, and prove the same fourth-root scale necessary for all tests. The maximality audit shows that Gao's weight is already minimax throughout the degree-two/degree-three motif class and uniquely minimax for the complete five-vertex motif, so no strict gain is claimed from these smallest non-degree-two cases. TiwariBasu2026 establishes validity for a different residual test but leaves theoretical local-power analysis unresolved. HarshawSavjeWang2022 informs the finite-dimensional Riesz geometry. KandirosHarshawSavje2026 informs the design-based Le Cam reduction. CommingesDalalyan2013 informs fourth-root quadratic testing. AtheyEcklesImbens2018, BasseFellerToulis2019, and HoshinoYanagi2026 provide focal-conditioning benchmarks without being theorem-level targets. Ni2026 surveys the design--power tension. PougetAbadieEtAl2019 supplies the LinkedIn-style Bernoulli network deployment.
prose_updates.technical_internal_limitation: The explicit hard-prior calculation proves a constant-factor converse. The bound \(H^2(P_{0,a},P_{1,a})\le C_{\cos}r\xi_Ha^4\) does not identify the exact local likelihood experiment or establish quadratic sufficiency. The exact maximality audit rules out a strict weight improvement for every minimum-degree-two motif of maximum degree at most three and for the complete five-vertex motif. Other motifs having a vertex of degree at least four remain unresolved locations for a strict gain. The exact local power function and quadratic completeness also remain open.
prose_updates.honest_scope: The claims proved here are the existing exact \(K_3\) and \(C_4\) constants, a fixed-motif input and certificate-verification bound, and a maximality audit of the smallest non-degree-two cases. Convexity and complement symmetry prove that Gao's weight minimizes worst bounded-schedule conditional variance for every minimum-degree-two motif of maximum degree at most three; direct complete-five-vertex enumeration proves that it is uniquely minimax there with motif value 2560. The Bernoulli-half moment-reproduction identities, Gao et al.'s squared-separation convention, and their quadratic weight remain imported background from GaoHarshawSavjeWang2026 Section 4 and Appendix B. No strict weight improvement is claimed. Exact elimination of the eight- and sixteen-row programs supplies the \(K_3\) and \(C_4\) values; the decimals are algebraic evaluations, not simulations. A strict witness on another motif of maximum degree at least four and the exact local power constant remain open.

statement_notes.justification: The audit resolves the requested first cases without guessing a gain: complement symmetry covers all maximum-degree-three motifs, and a positive-definite constant-schedule certificate plus a bounded-outcome upper envelope solves the complete five-vertex motif.
statement_notes.gap: The published Gao construction does not determine whether another unbiased quadratic weight has smaller repeated-motif worst-schedule conditional variance.
statement_notes.consumer: A design team may retain the Gao weight on these smallest non-degree-two motifs and reserve robust weight optimization for other graphs having degree at least four.

statement_notes.justification: The lemma exposes an explicit finite input and exact-verification budget as a function of motif size.
statement_notes.gap: The finite robust program previously lacked a stated motif-size bound for certificate checking.
statement_notes.consumer: Implementers can budget exact pre-experiment verification from the known motif size.
